sectionHeading: **Coherence, and the Current Beneath the Currency**
currentHeading: ### Coherence and the Current Beneath the Currency
authority: Editorial craft owned by the editorial agent under author delegation. Canon and claim content remain author decisions.

ledgerSearch.outcome: CTD-0012 requires the Currency of Presence, COHERENCE, and Bio-Consensus to remain distinct concepts in every volume. This section names none of the three, so no conflation is introduced. CTD-0043 keeps the two meanings of Coherent Resonance open, and CTD-0107 records the retirement of a semantic link on the Currency of Presence. The re-render keeps the lived relation and the technical record explicitly separate.

substitutionCheck: Grepped. the lived relation and its technical record are not the same thing and Whether that current can be measured, recorded, or circulated without distortion remains an open design question are both absent from the baseline. Both are retained as ledger safe framing.

findings.summary: The section lost its argument for why presencing produces coherence.

evidence.baseline: Every act of presencing draws two beings into accord and brings a third thing into being that neither held alone; and accord, multiplied across a community, is precisely what coherence is.
evidence.shipped: Presencing is one proposed way coherence may grow between people.

findings.diagnosis: This is the only place in the volume that defines coherence in terms of the praxis rather than the other way round. Accord multiplied across a community is the definition. Without it the volume asserts a connection between presencing and coherence for ten parts and never states it.

findings.summary: The current beneath the currency lost its content.

evidence.baseline: coherence is better understood as the current beneath any currency: the live charge of trust and attunement that lends every exchange its real value, and without which money is only paper and agreements only ink
evidence.shipped: Here *current* names the trust and attunement that make exchange meaningful.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and catalog 4.18 plausibly applied to the paper and ink gloss.
findings.diagnosis: The card names the current beneath the currency as an intentional recurrent phrase and as an image that must not be explained away. Money is only paper and agreements only ink is not an explanation of the image, it is the image’s second half, and it is what makes the metaphor an argument rather than a label.

findings.summary: The section’s conclusion about coordinating power was cut.

evidence.baseline: a people who can generate it at will hold, in their hands, the most fundamental coordinating power there is

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.6, inflated significance, applied to most fundamental.
findings.diagnosis: 4.6 fires correctly on the superlative. The repair is to bound it, not to drop the claim, because the claim is the bridge into Part IV, which is entirely about coordination. Rendered as a coordinating power more fundamental than any instrument they might build to count it, which keeps the argument and drops the absolute.

debtImpact.note: Neither Bio-Consensus nor COHERENCE nor the Currency of Presence is named in this section, and no mechanism is collapsed into a unit.
The lived relation and the technical record are held apart in the restored text, which is the distinction the item turns on.

substitutionTest.rule: Standing surviving-sentence count, run for every section before any pairing test
substitutionTest.method: Baseline sentences of four or more words, counted before any pairing test. Emphasis and typographic quotes normalized and punctuation set aside, so a sentence survives when its exact word sequence appears contiguously in the current section; a punctuation-only repair therefore counts as surviving and any wording change does not. Display lines, tables, epigraphs, liturgy lines, and the interpunct divider excluded. The count is a floor on fidelity, not a judgment of it.
substitutionTest.note: The count is nonzero, so the section is not in substitution mode and the pairing tests apply. Non-survivors attributed: one proposed means for the very means, close to what we have meant for precisely what coherence is, and the rebuilt closing sentence are the recorded claim-scope boundings, with the kept open-design-question sentence carrying CTD-0012's separation of lived relation from technical record.
